title: 774. Minimize Max Distance to Gas Station
hints: This is a portable adaptation: take integer stations and return the optimum as a double-parseable decimal string (tolerance 1e-5).
Decide feasibility for a guess D: each gap of length g needs ceil(g / D) - 1 new stops; sum over gaps and compare with k.
Feasibility is monotone in D, so binary-search the smallest feasible D (about 60 halvings from [0, 1e8]).
